calls.statement: SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx FROM fact_web_order

WITH o AS (
 SELECT w.*, (order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS loc_ts
 FROM fact_web_order w
 WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-02 12:00:00')
SELECT 'utc_date' k, count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01') all_orders,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') noncancel FROM o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'helsinki_date', count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(loc_ts AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01'),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(loc_ts AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') FROM o

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) n,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sale_date = CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)) eq_utc,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sale_date = CAST((sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)) eq_hel,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE sale_date <> CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) AND sale_date <> CAST((sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)) neither
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-25' AND DATE '2025-12-05'

WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00:00'),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) lines, min(sale_date) d FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) orders, count(l.receipt_id) with_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.receipt_id IS NULL) without_lines,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.lines<>o.line_count) linecount_mismatch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.d<>DATE '2025-12-01') line_date_not_dec1
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
